item.title: Academic Focus
item.description:
Areas of interest

  • Afroasiatic, Semitic, and Indo-European languages
  • Writing systems and orthographies
  • Phonetics and phonology
  • Grammar and syntactic change
  • Historical linguistics

Methodological interests

  • Language change in lived communities
  • Script evolution and sociopolitical context
  • Usage-based norms and speaker authority

item.title: Competitions & Olympiads
item.description:
Swedish Linguistics Olympiad

  • Finalist (2022, 2024)
  • Organizer (2024–present)
  • Board Member (2025–present)

International Linguistics Olympiad

  • Competitor for the Swedish National Team (2022, 2024)
  • Honorable Mention, Team Competition (2024)
  • Ethics Committee Member (2025–present)

Ethics Committee work

Focus on fairness, safeguarding, and institutional responsibility in international competitions.

item.title: Linguistics Projects
item.description:
